blocks.card.summary: Adults working through trauma, grief, anxiety, and perfectionism.
blocks.hero.subhead: Helps emerging adults, young adults, and adults stuck in anxiety, grief, life transitions, or hard relationships find a safe place to be seen, heal, and take practical steps toward peace.
blocks.quote: Healing happens one small step at a time, and I'll be right there with you.

sections.heading: Who Staci works with
sections.body: Staci works with emerging adults, young adults, and adults, especially those walking through trauma, grief, life transitions, spiritual questions, perfectionism, or relationship struggles. She works well with people open to looking at the whole person: body, mind, relationships, and faith.

sections.heading: Staci's approach
sections.body: Staci is a Licensed Professional Counselor Associate with a Master of Arts in Counseling. She's EMDRIA Certified in EMDR and a Prepare and Enrich facilitator. Her approach is psychodynamic and trauma-focused, and it looks at the whole person. Counseling with Staci is judgment-free and pressure-free, and you move at a pace that respects your readiness.

blocks.practical.body: In person in Middletown or online, including EMDR. Usually seen the same week.
blocks.faith.heading: Faith
blocks.faith.body: When you want it, Staci brings prayer, Scripture, mindfulness, and spiritual reflection into your work together, in line with your values. When you don't, she follows your lead.
blocks.request.heading: Ready to start with Staci?
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment with Staci, or call (502) 523-2970.
